title: Armwrestling champion invites Rochdale residents to free Drake Street challenge
excerpt: Grushka House will host coaching and demonstrations with Agy ‘Armpower’ Gorzynska on 6 December. Everyone attending, including spectators, must book ahead.
body:
Rochdale residents can try armwrestling with world champion Agy ‘Armpower’ Gorzynska at a free event on Drake Street next month.

Grushka House, at 55 Drake Street, will host the visit on Sunday 6 December 2026, from 11am to 5pm. Places are limited and advance booking is required for everyone, including people who only want to watch.

Owner Grazyna, known as Grace, says Gorzynska will lead four sessions lasting about 30 to 40 minutes each. The programme includes demonstrations, coaching for beginners and a chance for guests to try the sport under her guidance. There will also be opportunities to chat between sessions.

Gorzynska represents Great Britain. Her sponsor Fresh Start Waste documented her world championship gold in France in 2022. More recent results published by the Polish armwrestling association list her as the winner of both left and right arm events in the women’s grand masters over 70kg category at the 2026 IFA European Championships.

The visit brings a chance to learn from an experienced competitor to the town centre, without having to enter a tournament. The organiser says reservations can be made by messaging Grushka House and will be confirmed individually. The venue’s poster says registration details will also appear on its Facebook event page.

Grushka House serves coffee, cakes and Polish food, and hosts workshops and community gatherings. Its address is 55 Drake Street, Rochdale, OL16 1RX.

The event also has a commercial element: Gorzynska will attend as a Zinzino brand ambassador and information about the company’s products will be available, according to the organiser. Food and drinks will be sold separately from the free admission.

Anyone planning to take part or spectate should secure a confirmed place before travelling. What would you ask an armwrestling champion about getting started in the sport? Share your questions in the comments.

Sources: Grushka House event submission and supplied promotional poster, received 18 November 2026; Fresh Start Waste’s account of Gorzynska’s 2022 title, https://www.fswaste.co.uk/fresh-start-waste-sponsor-agy-armpower-gorzynska/ ; Polish armwrestling association’s 2026 European Championship results, https://armwrestling.pl/wyniki/fa-european-armwrestling-championships-2026 .
